project.name: Jungle Land community archive prototype
project.summary: A statically exported Next.js site with history pages, filterable example memories and client-only contribution forms. No submission backend, newsletter service or virtual recreation is implemented.

nodes.label: Site shell and navigation
nodes.summary: Shared fonts, page framing and responsive navigation wrap every page.

nodes.label: Archive and history pages
nodes.summary: Home, history, gallery and future-vision pages compose the shared components.

nodes.label: Example memory browser
nodes.summary: A local array supplies category counts and cards; filtering is client state.

nodes.label: Client-only contribution forms
nodes.summary: Memory and newsletter forms acknowledge locally without sending or saving data.

nodes.label: Static export and style configuration
nodes.summary: Next exports static pages, Tailwind styles source templates and TypeScript defines compiler and alias settings.

edges.label: Build static pages and styles
edges.description: Next export and font/style configuration supply the rendered site shell.

edges.label: Navigate between archive pages
edges.description: Header and footer links lead to the five declared pages.

edges.label: Compose the gallery and examples
edges.description: Home and gallery pages use local memory presentation; no remote archive is fetched.

edges.label: Invite a contribution
edges.description: Calls to action link to the submission page; home includes newsletter signup.

edges.label: Acknowledge only in browser state
edges.description: Submission changes React state and renders a summary; newsletter changes its joined flag. Neither writes to an API or database.

steps.note: The gallery page mounts GalleryGrid and explains that the archive cards are examples.
Select a category; filter the local memories array and display matching MemoryCard components with example badges.
Follow a contribution link to the submission page.
Enter optional details and story, add or remove File objects and give consent. Clicking submit changes client state only; the displayed upload limit is not enforced by addFiles.
Read the local thank-you summary or reset the form. Nothing is uploaded, persisted or published.

tour.title: A static site, not an archive service
tour.note: The shared layout loads fonts and navigation; next.config.js requests a static export.

tour.title: Examples are deliberately labelled
tour.note: The data module contains sample contribution ideas. Filtering does not retrieve real submissions.

tour.title: History and virtual recreation are provisional
tour.note: History content is marked approximate; the virtual page is a future-phase proposal, not an implemented interactive model.

tour.title: Thank-you text is not a receipt
tour.note: The form and newsletter handlers only change React state. The optimistic UI wording does not prove storage, review or mailing-list enrollment.

tour.title: Build settings are part of the source boundary
tour.note: Package and compiler/style configuration are individually described. Original image assets remain in the repository and freshness policy; they are not executable map nodes.
